html: Big week for smoother streaming! We rolled out a smarter video conversion process that automatically reformats trickier titles so they play cleanly on any device — TV, phone, or tablet — cutting down on stuttering and playback hiccups. We also sped up how quickly new titles get processed after being added, tightened quality checks so oddly-packaged discs don't sneak in looking broken, and added a dedicated Anime Movies section for easier browsing. 🎬
